formal.methodology: unchanged shared complete-output harness; 11 rotating paired rounds, 3 persistent workers
formal.iterations: 5 calls per round for M<256 (including long/wide rectangles), otherwise 1
formal.invariants: full native output bitwise to old scalar; NJIT original 1e-11 tolerance; sampled fsum outside timing
formal.memory: graph/setup/first numeric call inside cold; input hash may allocate/free before epoch; separate heap/RSS children

original_phase2.scope: separate original CPU-budget-4 gate; unchanged thresholds; current cache-blocking build; failures remain failures

group_scope: expected path cohorts inferred from recorded float64 input strides, all dimensions >=32: repeated first requires A row stride0 and compatible C/F B; blocked next requires C-right B column stride8, row stride>=N*8, and K*(4+8)*8>65536 (integer K>=683); all other inputs unchanged; not a fabricated ISA counter or cache hardware claim

limitations: Full public outputs are measured; this is not the preallocated kernel screen.
11 round clusters on one persistent process per backend; not 11 independent process replicates. Bootstrap bounds are descriptive and unadjusted.
One heap and one RSS child per backend/case; no repeated-process RSS confidence interval.
Input hashing may allocate/free a full copy before the request; allocator is not pristine.
Heap cold/warm peaks already include live setup; never add peaks or RSS fields.
Audit covers observable copies only; direct counters are not collected.
Fixed byte increases and positive RSS differences are disclosed, not labelled zero or noise.
Original Phase-2 gate failures remain valid even when all formal measurement children complete.
Stack/OS-library pages require separate evidence; no automatic joint acceptance.
